author: Steve Kuckuk
text: I would attach them, but after the first 24 hours, I would be checking often against a traditional blood sugar meter… If they were close enough, I would continue, but if they were way off, then junk them . . . I could be off base here, but I think the real issue is the life of the battery that is in the sensor… If the battery works, you’ll know right away, if it fails, then it won’t even activate.
